audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant cash + debt >= cash_reserve holds across all operations. withdraw_underlying enforces the stricter cash >= cash_reserve.ceil() after every cash outflow (borrow, burn, liquidate, take_revenue). accrue_interest increases cash_reserve by reserve_factor * interest and debt by interest; since reserve_factor = repay_fee_rate/DECIMAL_DENOMINATOR is bounded to <= 1 at the admin entry point (asset_admin.move:81), delta_cash_reserve <= delta_debt, so the sum cash + debt - cash_reserve is non-decreasing. Deposit, repay, and flash loan paths also preserve the invariant algebraically.
